about: The Workbench icons of the Freedroid drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/freedroidclassic.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, MIT; art/freedroidclassic.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. drawer.info is the Freedroid drawer's own icon, installed as Freedroid.info beside it.
